name: Gnoam Sprecklesprocket
summary: In the Deadmines, Shoni the Shilent seeks a power source for the effort to reach Gnomeregan. Gnoam Sprecklesprocket can drive drilling machines meant to breach the rock around the lost gnomish home.

sections.title: A Vital Power Source
sections.body: Deep in the Defias stronghold, Sneed's shredder cuts timber under the goblin taskmaster Sneed's hand. Its compact power core drives heavy logging and cutting blades. The Gnoam Sprecklesprocket gives the machine steady power, making it valuable salvage in Westfall's tunnels.

sections.title: Breaching Gnomeregan
sections.body: In Stormwind City, the gnomish inventor Shoni the Shilent has chosen the Deadmines shredder for a greater effort. Gnomish forces seek to reclaim Gnomeregan from the troggs who overran it, but sealed underground approaches bar the way. Shoni plans to power heavy gyrodrillmatic excavationators with the Sprecklesprocket. The machines could bore through bedrock around the lost techno-city and open an unexpected route for an underground assault.

faq.answer: The Gnoam Sprecklesprocket is a high-output power supply from a goblin shredder deep in the Deadmines. It can power heavy underground drilling machines.

faq.q: Where does the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket come from?
faq.answer: The Gnoam Sprecklesprocket comes from Sneed's Shredder, an industrial lumber machine in the Deadmines lumber mills. The goblin taskmaster Sneed operates it.

faq.q: Why does Shoni the Shilent need it?
faq.answer: Shoni the Shilent needs the sprocket to power gyrodrillmatic excavationators. The machines can bore through the rock around Gnomeregan and open a route for gnomes aligned with the Alliance to assault the troggs.

faq.q: Is the sprocket goblin or gnomish technology?
faq.answer: The sprocket comes from a working goblin shredder in the Deadmines, and Shoni plans to use it in gnomish drilling machinery. Who first designed the component is not said.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can bring each salvaged component closer to drilling into your lost home and driving out the troggs.
As an engineer, you can see how this intact power supply could run machinery to bore through Gnomeregan's underground rock barriers.
